headline: Diesel already at 100 hryvnias: why fuel is getting more expensive in Ukraine and what will happen with prices next
summary: Diesel in Ukraine has reached 100 hryvnias per litre as fuel prices rise. The increase is linked to the situation on the world market.
why: Fuel prices feed into transport costs, inflation and margins across the economy, and diesel is a key global benchmark product.
